legend_note: How much labelled performing arts and music a commune can reach: operas, orchestras, scènes nationales, national drama, dance and circus centres, SMAC music venues, Zéniths, city theatres and conservatoires. Each venue counts fully on the spot, half at 15 km, a quarter at 30 km, nothing beyond 45 km, weighted by its label. 0–100 is the share of communes with less within reach. Straight-line distance; labels follow public subsidy, so private halls and clubs are missing.

legend_note: How much museum and contemporary art a commune can reach: every Musée de France weighted by its attendance, plus FRACs and national contemporary art centres. Each counts fully on the spot, half at 15 km, a quarter at 30 km, nothing beyond 45 km. 0–100 is the share of communes with less within reach. Straight-line distance; private galleries are not included.

legend_note: How many festivals a commune can reach, from the Ministry of Culture's 2019 national map. Each counts fully on the spot, half at 15 km, a quarter at 30 km, nothing beyond 45 km, weighted by the reach it declares and how long it has run; there is no attendance to go on. 0–100 is the share of communes with less within reach.
